areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Strong adherence: general objective and most specific objectives align; large resources for integrated drainage, mobility, green and housing actions; high expected impact.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Nature-based solutions and a protected area are relevant, but their share of the investment is limited, so impact is low and adherence restricted.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Detention and containment works plus a flood-area indicator relate directly; impact moderate given relative weight in the project.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Municipal solar generation and LED lighting reduce consumption, but scope is local and a limited share of investment; low impact.

areas.name: Logistics and transport
areas.reason: Rural bridge and culvert works improve access and logistics, but scope is local and small within the project; low impact.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Municipal management capacity and information-security/integrated operations actions relate directly; impact moderate since they are a minor part of the investments.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Digital services portal, cybersecurity and data-integration actions are relevant but a limited share of investments; low impact.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Parks serve recreation but aim at green areas and urban quality, not structured sport or physical-activity promotion; counted under other areas.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: No productive-sector actions; rural access benefits to production are indirect.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: No components or indicators aimed at productivity; economic effects are indirect externalities.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Interventions focus on risk reduction and ecosystem recovery, not water availability or multiple uses; counted under other areas.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Benefits are local socio-environmental vulnerability reduction, not reduction of regional inequalities.
